_comment: TIMESHIFT Configuration File - Edit values as needed
_rtsp_url_help: Full RTSP stream URL including credentials. Format: rtsp://username:password@ip:port/path
_capture_time_help: Time to create daily timelapse (24-hour format HH:MM)
_capture_start_time_help: Start capturing frames at this time (24-hour format HH:MM)
_capture_stop_time_help: Stop capturing frames at this time (24-hour format HH:MM)
_capture_schedule_enabled_help: Enable to only capture during start/stop time window (useful for daylight-only capture)
_fps_help: Frames per second for output timelapse video (typical: 24-60)
_frame_interval_help: Seconds between frame captures. 300 = 5 minutes, 600 = 10 minutes
_enabled_help: Enable/disable automatic capturing. Set to true to start capturing
_total_frames_captured_help: Total number of frames captured (automatically updated)
